notes.title: Blask 2 is OUT!
notes.content:
Blask 2 is OUT! More levels and mechanics. More fun!


Features:

- 80 levels

- Unique mechanic where you combine and rotate shapes to control laser beam reflections

- Each puzzle can be solved in multiple ways

- Two difficulty settings

- Relaxing soundtrack

- Many new mechanics compared to BLASK

- Colorful calming backgrounds

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1395190/BLASK_2/

notes.title: Big Update
notes.content:
This is a major update to BLASK. It is also 30% off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34103347/6e421f136041f8d89c4cf455b3203545c43869b6.png[/img]

Features
[list]
[*] EASY game mode   (each laser has the same length - bounces 3 times like blue laser in hard mode)
[*] 2 new music tracks
[*] added level selection screen (if you want to go back to previous levels easily)
[*] proper main menu (finally...)
[*] bug fixes
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34103347/a8bb3ddb2bcff01918219a44d3e4cc75ab2a3e02.png[/img]

Thank you for playing!

BLASK 2 is coming soon you can wishlist it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1395190/BLASK_2/
